notes: scan059.N1: The author reconsiders the size of the previously discussed pieces, contrasts general pieces with successor pieces, and proposes a fibre/cylinder description under smoothness and local-triviality hypotheses. The statements were carried as background while reading; the hypotheses are not specified enough on this one leaf for this reader to claim a proof.

scan059.N2: The top indexed expression has a scripted V whose possible internal dot remains uncertain, a three-stroke approxeq, and an N with preferred check but an explicit tilde alternative, followed by restriction to D_{d_*}^*. Every d prime/star and the two subscript zeros were inspected together with the whole formula. The source reference p. 84 is retained without consulting that referenced page. See N13 for the final blind adjudication of the V and N alternatives.

scan059.N3: Literal irregularities remain: côtes mal taillées with ils, the still-doubtful masculine adjective, two closing parentheses after fermées, the unbalanced outer où parenthesis, and the unfinished final Quand. No text is supplied to complete the page.

scan059.N4: The main homéomorphe callout is qualified by the starred marginal note: the claim is restricted by X_i^*=X_i and dotted X_i empty, with a drawing illustrating extra pieces otherwise. The sideways NB then questions whether that real picture fits the stated hypotheses and proposes splitting the displayed stratum. This reports the author's caveats without asserting a theorem not proved here.

scan059.N5: The two live additions are particulièrement and the parenthetical Z equality. Their leaders are not strikes. The only separately cancelled textual groups are est and the dense des cas candidate; both stay doubtful. H's alleged stratification insertion comes from diagonal marginal ink crossing the main baseline.

scan059.N6: Local short forms and punctuation remain distinct: overbarred m is not expanded; top has no stop; main i.e. has two stops but marginal i.e has no separable final stop; the comma after the marginal second Xi is retained only as doubtful. Main prose du type and marginal de type are not harmonized.

scan059.N7: The two drawings are fully encoded in TikZ. The small line drawing has one Xi label, not C's duplicate prose-plus-figure occurrence. The larger drawing retains both wavy borders, the straight axis, unequal crossing stroke weights, central fill, a small upper filled dot, a separate lower filled blot, Roman I/II, the upward dotted-Xi arrow, two curved arrows with distinct origins and endpoints, the grouping brace and its doubtful barred-V label below-left.

scan059.N8: The parenthesized drawing label's overbar and scripted V body are visible, but the index remains overwritten. M1015 stays undecided. M1009 likewise stays undecided over the reduced a/e in généraux/généreux; removing the unsupported générales option is a certainty refinement, not a C textual correction.

scan059.N9: Each repeated symbol or quote endpoint is collated separately where it changes. The first C in R times C has i,j, as do the NB V and second inserted Z; the first inserted Z has ij. The remaining C indices are not automatically given commas. H editorial prose and thin-space tokens are not treated as manuscript text.

scan059.N10. First-pass accounting, retained as history; the final reconciled totals are in the changes summary and this report’s counts object. Counting uses physical change rows with diff flags and includes tentative disagreements, excluding pure macro/provenance and certainty-only differences. There are 105 substantive rows: C 22 (21 secure, 1 tentative), H 94 (91 secure, 3 tentative); 11 affect both, 11 C only and 83 H only. The union contains 102 secure and 3 tentative rows. Nine supplied marks yield 4 first, 1 alternative, 2 other and 2 undecided decisions. There are 18 distinct crops/audit boxes, 19 inventory elements and 49 covered difference rows.

scan059.N11: During the first reading, the whole page and both native halves were visually read once each, including all agreed text. Eighteen distinct crops were inspected. Boundary-only extensions to r02/r04/r05/r07/r09/r11/r12 were checked to include descenders, ascenders, quote endpoints and target context, without changing readings. Root independently saw all final crops. r13/r18 are rotated clockwise 90 degrees; r14/r15/r17 clockwise 43 degrees; boxes remain original source coordinates. The isolated first reader used no other-page image or report. No OCR, external research or TeX compilation was used at any stage. The later main-reader comparison with scan058 is documented in N13.

scan059.N12: Top 17 is authorial dark numbering; bottom 58 is pale foliation by another hand. The latter is encoded as margin text. Its wrapper change is provenance-only relative to C; both omitted written numbers count as H omissions.

scan059.N13. Blind adjudication adds explicit alternatives for the small internal point of the top V, the N accent, two occurrences of the tall initial in standart, three colon-like reduced à forms, the crowded opening parenthesis before qui, and the following C subscript. The larger reduced à before fibre un cylindre has a recoverable lower curve and remains unqualified. The local du/de distinction remains. All three construction nouns read pierres by their paired r shoulders, compared with scan058; the independent pieuvres proposal was rejected from those strokes. The marginal prose, literal phi form and detailed drawing survive the audit. The independent second reader’s encoding of the large drawing omits a visible small upper dot; the retained first encoding includes it. These certainty additions introduce no extra substantive comparison rows; final changes already present are updated in place.
